english_description: A signed calendar year with the Gregorian validity and leap-year queries used by the supported date subset.

queries.english: Whether the stored year lies in the supported signed-short domain.
Whether the stored year satisfies the Gregorian leap-year rule.

constraints.english: ok() is true exactly when the stored signed 16-bit year is not -32768.
is_leap() follows the Gregorian divisible-by-four, century, and divisible-by-four-hundred rule.

adversary_table.scenario: The reserved signed-short value -32768 is passed to ok().
adversary_table.resolution: Return false because -32768 is outside the supported year domain.

adversary_table.scenario: The century year 1900 is classified as a leap year.
adversary_table.resolution: Return false because 1900 is divisible by 100 but not by 400.

source_references.notes: Pinned C++ representation, supported year bounds, ok(), and Gregorian is_leap() implementation; supported by accepted E-5 and E-12.
Creusot implementation and ensures clauses for Year::ok and Year::is_leap.
